newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index down by 5.56 points.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index down by 5.56 points.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Friday closed down by 5.56 points in lower trade on nervousness about new trading rules, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 606.26 from 611.83 on Thursday.
Trade volume was 789,455 dinars against 1.291 million dinars.
The new trading rules are expected to be outlined by Finance Minister Nouri Zorgati at a meeting with traders on Saturday.
"The market is nervous ahead the annoucement of the new trading rules," a broker said.
Beverages firm SFBT was down 4.26 dinars to 137.74 dinars. Amen bank down 1.83 dinar to 59.17 dinars. Investment fund SPDIT was down 1.26 dinar to 40.62 dinars.
Retail stores Monoprix was up 0.89 dinar to 47.45 dinars.
